episode_summary: In this episode, Alex Maldonado shares strategies for helping first-time buyers overcome financial hurdles by using seller and lender credits. He emphasizes the importance of optimizing Google business profiles and leveraging bilingual marketing to reach the Hispanic community. Alex also discusses effective lead generation techniques and the value of consistent social media content.
